summary: Physical occurrence identity is stored but never authenticated
evidence: architecture-schema.sql:154 stores occurrence_ordinal as a standalone integer, calls has no occurrence discriminator, and lib/arch_index/arch_index_bindings.ml:799 validates only caller_name plus file:start_line. A nonexistent or swapped same-line ordinal can still finalize.
fix: Persist a keyed physical occurrence inventory, foreign-key witnesses and candidates to it, and add same-line mutation and ambiguity tests.

summary: The actual/member-to-target witness chain is not authenticated
evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_bindings.ml:799-811 checks only nonempty actual_path/member_path JSON and that the target function belongs to the source module. It never proves that resolving that actual member yields target_function_id.
fix: Persist an exact export/body identity for the resolved member and validate it through keyed candidate/target links; add member-path and same-source target swap corruption tests.

summary: Nonidentical variants borrow representative proofs instead of reconciling artifact-local proofs
evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index_cmt.ml:3659-3674 returns before variant calls and targets are collected after a source-digest plus signature match; lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:1880-1902 then copies representative witnesses under the variant artifact. No zero/one/multiple stable-field occurrence reconciliation runs.
fix: Collect each variant's complete local proof before graph insertion loss, normalize only source-stable occurrence fields, reconcile to exactly one representative occurrence, and attach only that artifact's facts.

summary: Target-storage failures do not preserve the required failed-input lifecycle
evidence: lib/arch_index/arch_index.ml:1901-1909 commits candidate calls before target witness storage; on store_target_collected failure the catch only logs and disables finalization. It records no collection_failed target input and leaves an unwitnessed positive call usable by consumers that do not consult functor_target_contract.
fix: Make candidate and witness persistence atomic or quarantine rejected candidates, always record a recoverable collection_failed input, and add injected input/witness/failed-row storage tests.

summary: Required binding, member, and reconciliation refusal counters are absent
evidence: roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-cmt.js:82 emits only a generic pass marker. Neither the producer nor CHECK-1 reports distinct deterministic binding, member and reconciliation refusal counts for FR-026.
fix: Persist deterministic refusal categories, emit exact sorted aggregates in CHECK-1, and compare them under reordered discovery and authentic refusal fixtures.

summary: CHECK-1 omits required arch-query and ambiguous-reconciliation verification
evidence: roster/ocaml-functor-targets/check-cmt.js:45-82 builds arch-query but never invokes it for Stage-4 targets; its fixtures do not exercise zero/multiple representative matches, and the default gate does not execute its own control branches.
fix: Add target-aware arch-query assertions, absent and ambiguous nonidentical-variant fixtures, and explicit three-mode control invocations in the validated QA commands.
